# QUESTIONs with `line` `transient-support`

*Lines of inquiry — A named line of the record's own argument, so that a line can be set aside as a whole and what depends on it can be found. Retracting a line is a status change on its members, never a deletion (ADR-032).*

**Withdrawing transient support** — when support that establishes or sustains a party can be withdrawn without its decline — supplied upkeep that never becomes optional, supply that does the party's work and lowers the capacity it keeps, a savings buffer as a stock of time, dependency against division of labour by who supplies, and independence from what founded an organization against independence from what feeds it; split from readiness (ADR-087).

| [QUESTION-398](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-398.md) v3 | Under what conditions does a partial organization become independent of the intervention that originally established it? | A's question, verbatim, from the fourth synthesis on DNA origami pasted by the owner on 2026-11-05, Prediction 6 and §10. A's test: establish a nucleus with external support, withdraw the support at matched intermediate states, and measure D(s) = q_supported(s) − q_withdrawn(s), the drop in the chance of completing when support is removed. A expects D to be large early and to approach zero once enough downstream organization has formed. A sharp fall would be an operational signature of a nucleation threshold. A separates becoming independent of the support during formation from maintenance: "The nucleus can become unnecessary while the organization it helped establish persists". The wording is A's; adopting it is the owner's call. | Open |
